description: This source file defines the ManageReviewMenuConfigurator class, which implements the MenuConfigurator interface for configuring menu items related to performance review management within the OrangeHRM system. It primarily overrides a specific screen related to performance review search functionality.

classes.name: ManageReviewMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class responsible for configuring menu items related to performance review management by overriding specific screens in the OrangeHRM performance module.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the default screen with 'searchPerformanceReview' in the current module for the performance review menu.
